svg.title: Cognidamesh open-source blueprint
svg.desc: Architecture diagram connecting human direction and Paperclip to agent runtimes, harness guardrails, skills and MCP tools, research services, Hindsight memory and inference. Coding and reverse-engineering agents drive Unsloth retraining and send evaluated models to inference.
